nodes.label: Development Compose Stack
nodes.rationale: A development database and nothing else — no API, no edge. The dev and prod files are kept apart so a committed development password can never become a production one.

nodes.label: db — postgres:15-alpine (dev)
nodes.rationale: Container pgp-db, published on host port 5433 so it does not collide with a local Postgres. Passwords default to pgp_local_dev / pgp_local_app. The app role created by 01-app-role.sh is deliberately not the owner, so the REVOKE that enforces R7 bites.

nodes.label: Postgres Init Scripts Mount
nodes.rationale: ./docker/postgres/init mounted read-only at /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d, running once on first initialisation of an empty data volume. Mounted identically by both dev and prod.
